reviews.text: I had my hair balayage done and I’m absolutely in love with the results! The team were brilliant — so attentive, professional, and made sure I was comfortable throughout the whole appointment. They really listened to what I wanted and paid attention to every detail. The service was amazing, and I left feeling so happy and confident with my hair. Thank you so much for the beautiful work — I highly recommend!
reviews.author: Yasmin Begum

reviews.text: Amazing salon, plenty of parking and easy to get to. I had a wash, cut and blow dry and I love my new hair — it feels so much healthier. I'm definitely coming back to Essence next time.
reviews.author: Henna

reviews.text: I highly recommend the Nanoplastia treatment if you struggle with unmanageable hair. I have thick, frizzy, curly hair and this has drastically reduced my styling time — cutting it in half.
reviews.author: Tamanna
